at.chat.break: §cYou must have Tier %s §ctool to break that.

at.chat.2: §cThis creature has %s §cTier, your damage significantly lowered.
at.buff.1: 1) The creature deals more damage and takes less damage if it has a Power advantage. The greater the advantage, the stronger the effect.
at.buff.2: 2) Each point of Power grants +0.1% to all current attributes.
at.buff.3: 3) If the creature's Power is 10 times higher than the monster's, the monster will be unable to target the creature for an attack.
at.debuff.1:
1 and higher:
Loss of all Power bonuses.
For each point exceeded, you will take more damage and deal less damage, equipment will lose durability faster.
at.debuff.2:
10% and higher:
When taking damage, there is a 10% chance that enchantments will be removed from equipment and buffs will be removed from the player (100% chance upon death).
at.debuff.3:
25% and higher:
In addition to the 10% effect, instead of being removed, enchantments will be replaced with curses and buffs with debuffs. The chance is equal to the percentage of exceeded Power.
at.debuff.4:
50% and higher:
Experience points gradually drain.
Taking damage has a 5% chance of causing instant death.
at.debuff.5:
100% and higher:
Death chance +5%.
Upon death, the entire inventory is cleared.
